Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: send gift
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Send silver from your colony as a gift. Raises goodwill and their opinion of you.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: compliment
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Send warm words through official channels. Usually raises their opinion of you a little; sometimes it falls flat.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: insult
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Insult them openly. Lowers goodwill and their opinion of you, and they will remember it.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: propose peace
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Ask an enemy for peace. War-weary, dovish factions, and those weaker than you, are more willing. Peace starts a 30-day truce.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: declare war
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Declare war. Every treaty with them is broken, which costs you reputation with every faction.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: propose treaty
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Propose a formal treaty. Each treaty has its own influence cost and acceptance chance.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: set border policy
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Open, restrict (traders only) or close your borders to this faction. Closing them offends.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: declare or lift embargo
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Refuse all trade with this faction. Their caravans stop coming, you cannot trade at their settlements, and their economy suffers.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: denounce
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Denounce them publicly. They resent it; their enemies warm to you and their allies cool.

Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.label: demand tribute
Dominion.DiplomacyActionDef.description: Demand silver under threat. Works only if you are clearly stronger, and they will resent it either way.
